description: Fix Bug 2: After app restart, completed torrents are NOT re-added to WebTorrent (intentional). torrent:get-metadata IPC handler calls only torrentEngine.getMetadata(infoHash), which requires the torrent to be in this.client.torrents. It throws, failWithLog returns operation-failed, GeneralTab shows the error. Fix: add _metadataCache in DownloadManagerImpl (pattern from fileCatalog), capture metadata when torrent completes, persist/restore the fields in PersistedDownloadItem, and fall back to cache in the IPC handler when the engine throws.
steps: In shared/types.ts, in the PersistedDownloadItem interface add three optional fields after the existing 'files?' field: 'creator?: string | null;', 'comment?: string | null;', 'creationDate?: number | null;'. These are optional for backward compatibility — old sessions without them have undefined, which means no cache entry is populated on restore.

In main/downloadManager.ts, add 'getCachedMetadata(infoHash: string): TorrentMetadata | undefined;' to the exported DownloadManager interface, after the 'getQueueOrder' line. Then in DownloadManagerImpl, add 'private readonly _metadataCache = new Map<string, TorrentMetadata>();' as a class field immediately after the 'private readonly fileCatalog' line. Add the implementation method: 'getCachedMetadata(infoHash: string): TorrentMetadata | undefined { return this._metadataCache.get(infoHash); }'. TorrentMetadata is already imported at the top of the file.

In main/downloadManager.ts, in the 'this.engine.on("done", ...)' handler, after 'this._clearMetadataTimer(infoHash);' and before constructing 'updated', insert: 'try { const meta = this.engine.getMetadata(infoHash); this._metadataCache.set(infoHash, meta); } catch { /* metadata may not be available */ }'. The torrent IS still in the engine at this point (pause happens afterward).

In main/downloadManager.ts, in the 'this.engine.on("progress", ...)' handler, in the 'if (selectedFilesComplete)' branch, insert the same try/catch metadata capture block immediately before 'void this.engine.pause(info.infoHash).catch(...)'.

In main/downloadManager.ts, in the 'persistSession' method, in the items.map callback, after the line 'const cachedMeta = ...' (add it: 'const cachedMeta = this._metadataCache.get(item.infoHash);'), add to the returned object's spread: '...(cachedMeta !== undefined ? { creator: cachedMeta.creator, comment: cachedMeta.comment, creationDate: cachedMeta.creationDate } : {})'.

In main/downloadManager.ts, in the 'restoreSession' method, after the block that sets 'this.confirmedMetadata.set(persistedItem.infoHash, buffer)' (inside the torrentFileBase64 check), add: 'if (persistedItem.creator !== undefined) { this._metadataCache.set(persistedItem.infoHash, { infoHash: persistedItem.infoHash, creator: persistedItem.creator, comment: persistedItem.comment ?? null, creationDate: persistedItem.creationDate ?? null }); }'. Note: creator !== undefined distinguishes new data (string|null) from old data (undefined). Place this outside the torrentFileBase64 block so it works even when the torrent has no buffer stored.

In main/ipcHandler.ts, in the 'torrent:get-metadata' handler, replace the catch block from 'catch (err) { return failWithLog("torrent:get-metadata", err); }' with: 'catch (err) { const cached = downloadManager.getCachedMetadata(infoHash); if (cached) return ok(cached); return failWithLog("torrent:get-metadata", err); }'. The variable 'infoHash' is already in scope from the result.data destructuring above the try block. Note: the ENGINE_RESTARTING early return remains unchanged — it does NOT use the cache, per spec.

In tests/unit/downloadDetails/ipcHandlerDetails.test.ts, add 'getCachedMetadata: jest.fn().mockReturnValue(undefined)' to the makeMockDownloadManager factory. Add two new tests in the 'torrent:get-metadata' describe block: (a) 'usa cache quando engine.getMetadata lança (torrent completed após restart)' — setup: torrentEngine.getMetadata throws, downloadManager.getCachedMetadata returns valid TorrentMetadata; expect response.success=true and response.data matching the cached metadata. (b) 'retorna erro quando engine lança e cache está vazio' — setup: torrentEngine.getMetadata throws, getCachedMetadata returns undefined; expect response.success=false.

In tests/unit/downloadManager.test.ts, add a test in the 'done event' describe (or create one): after engine.emit('done', infoHash), call manager.getCachedMetadata(infoHash) and expect it to equal the TorrentMetadata that makeMockEngine's getMetadata mock returns. Pattern: create engine = makeMockEngine(), manager = createDownloadManager(engine, settings), await manager.addTorrentFile or addMagnetLink, emit progress to set status to downloading, emit done, then check getCachedMetadata.

In tests/integration/session-persistence.test.ts, add a test: 'persists and restores TorrentMetadata for completed torrents'. Pattern: add torrent, emit done event (populates cache), call manager.persistSession(), read persisted data from mock store, create new manager, call restoreSession, verify manager2.getCachedMetadata(infoHash) returns the expected TorrentMetadata. Use makeMockEngine with getMetadata mocked to return specific metadata.
acceptance_criteria: After engine emits 'done' for a torrent, getCachedMetadata(infoHash) returns its TorrentMetadata
After persistSession + restoreSession roundtrip, getCachedMetadata(infoHash) returns the saved metadata
torrent:get-metadata IPC handler returns ok(cachedMetadata) when torrentEngine.getMetadata throws and cache has data
torrent:get-metadata IPC handler returns failWithLog when both engine throws and cache is empty
PersistedDownloadItem's new fields are optional — old sessions without them restore without errors
npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath tests/unit/downloadDetails/ipcHandlerDetails.test.ts tests/unit/downloadManager.test.ts tests/integration/session-persistence.test.ts passes all tests
npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json reports no errors
npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.jest.json reports no errors
npm run lint reports no new errors
findings: Implemented as specified. Added TorrentMetadata import and _metadataCache: Map<string,TorrentMetadata> to DownloadManagerImpl (mirroring fileCatalog pattern). getCachedMetadata(infoHash) added to both DownloadManager interface and DownloadManagerImpl. Metadata capture (try/catch wrapping engine.getMetadata) inserted in both 'done' handler (after _clearMetadataTimer, before building updated) and 'progress' handler selectedFilesComplete branch (before void engine.pause). persistSession now spreads cachedMeta fields (creator/comment/creationDate) onto the persisted object. restoreSession restores cache from creator !== undefined check (outside the torrentFileBase64 block). ipcHandler torrent:get-metadata restructured: validation/early-returns moved outside try, only getMetadata() wrapped; catch now falls back to getCachedMetadata. makeMockDownloadManager in ipcHandlerDetails.test.ts updated with getCachedMetadata mock. Two new IPC cache tests added (engine throws + cache hit; engine throws + cache miss). One new unit test in downloadManager.test.ts (done event populates cache). One new integration test in session-persistence.test.ts (persist+restore round-trip). Integration verification (all 1577 tests, 98 suites): PASS. tsconfig.node.json, tsconfig.web.json, tsconfig.jest.json typecheck: clean. npm run lint: 0 errors. Integration fix applied: getCachedMetadata mock added to makeMockDownloadManager in ipcHandler.test.ts (the original non-details file), which was missing the mock that caused 'getCachedMetadata is not a function' in the existing test 'retorna erro quando getMetadata lança exceção'.
